narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this session, we'll embark on an exciting journey into the world of Arithmetic Progressions. You'll learn to define an arithmetic progression, understand its common difference, and recognize its general form. We'll differentiate between finite and infinite APs, and you'll master applying the nth term formula to find specific terms or missing values. Get ready to solve complex problems related to the nth term in various contexts. Additionally, we'll derive and use the formula for the sum of the first n terms, and tackle word problems involving the sum of n terms of an AP. Let's begin!
